name: Healthcare Practice Management: Morning brief
description: Weekdays at 07:30, builds each practice's morning brief: today's diary, bookings and cancellations since the last brief, the unread inbox's top priorities (Microsoft 365 practices), items waiting in WorkQ including referral alerts, and what was left open at yesterday's close-out. Saves it as a document, notifies the practice's digest recipients and emails it to them. Read-only: it never drafts, sends to a patient or changes the diary.
